content.rendered:
For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God. Hidden. Not exposed. Not at risk. Not vulnerable to whatever wind blows next. Your real life is tucked away inside the very life of Christ in God. Nothing can reach you there.

The Gospel For Today | Wednesday, July 8, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God. When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with him in glory.”
Colossians 3:3-4 (NIV)

Today’s Message

Paul writes Colossians 3 with a quiet pastoral confidence. He has spent the first two chapters of the letter laying out the supremacy of Christ over all things. Now he turns to what that means for the believer’s daily life, and he leads with one of the most beautiful images in the New Testament. The believer’s life is hidden with Christ in God. Two layers of security. Christ inside God. The believer’s life inside Christ. The most secure location in the universe.

The Greek verb Paul uses for “hidden” is kekruptai. It is in the perfect passive tense, meaning a completed past action whose effects continue into the present. The hiding has been done. The hiding remains. The believer is not in the process of being hidden. The believer is hidden. The verb form leaves no room for doubt. Whatever happens externally, the real life of the believer is safely tucked away inside the Triune God.

This matters for every season of life. In seasons when believers feel exposed, hunted, or vulnerable, the truth is that their deepest self is hidden where no enemy can reach. In seasons when believers feel obscure, unnoticed, or overlooked by the world, the truth is that their real life is treasured in the hands of the One whose notice matters most. In seasons when believers fear losing what they have built, the truth is that the real wealth of their life has been deposited where moths and rust cannot touch it. The hidden life is the secure life.

And Paul does not stop with the hiddenness. He looks forward. When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory. The hiddenness is for now. The appearing is coming. The current season of being concealed in Christ is the prelude to the day when believers will be revealed alongside Him in glory. The hiddenness is not the final chapter. It is the safe chamber where the believer is being prepared for the day of unveiling.

For Gospelbuzz readers, the truth this morning is steady. Whatever happens today, your real life is hidden. Hidden in Christ. Hidden in God. The exterior may be busy or quiet, celebrated or overlooked, easy or hard. The interior, the real you, is tucked away in the most secure location in all creation. Nothing can reach you there. Walk in that hiddenness today.

Prayer

Father, I acknowledge that my life is hidden with Christ in You. The real me is tucked away in the most secure location in the universe. Whatever happens on the surface today, the deepest self of who I am cannot be reached by any enemy, any loss, any season. I am hidden in Christ. Christ is in You. I am at home in the safest place there is. I walk today in the peace of the hidden life, knowing that when Christ appears, I too will appear with Him in glory. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

My life is hidden with Christ in God. The real me is secure in the Triune God. Nothing can reach me there. I walk in the peace of the hidden life today.
